jobs.o1_push: tall vertical picture: a plain room in the daytime. The main character stands on its hind legs, leaning forward and pushing with both front paws one big heavy plain grey cardboard box away from itself toward a plain bed on the right; the character's eyes are happily closed and it has a big relieved smile, as if a weight just fell off its shoulders; one small puff of dust flies from under the box. The flame on the tip of its tail burns bright. LAYOUT: the box is big and whole in the middle right, standing on the floor, its left side touching the character's paws; the main character is whole in the middle left; the bed is on the far right edge, only its foot end visible; plain wall above with wide clean space in the upper part; plain floor line; the box is plain and smooth, no tape, labels, letters or numbers.
jobs.o2_night: tall vertical picture: night in a dim bedroom in grey-blue shadow. The main character lies in a plain bed under a blanket, wide awake, eyes wide open and tired, staring up; from under the bed sticks out one corner of the big plain grey box, and on the wall above the bed looms a huge dark shadow shaped like that box, leaning over the character. The flame on the tip of its tail is a small dim ember with a thin wisp of smoke. LAYOUT: the bed with the character is whole in the lower half; the huge box shadow fills the wall in the upper half; the box corner is visible under the bed; no clock, no letters or numbers anywhere.
jobs.o3_two: tall vertical picture made of two equal panels one above the other with a plain gap between them, the same plain room in both. TOP PANEL: the main character stands in front of a plain round mirror, frowning and pointing a stern paw at its own reflection, scolding itself; behind it the plain grey box is enormous, towering up to the ceiling. BOTTOM PANEL: the same character stands calmly with one front paw on its chest and a soft kind smile; behind it the same grey box is small, only knee high. The flame on its tail is dim in the top panel and bright in the bottom panel. LAYOUT: both panels the same size; the character whole in each panel; plain walls; no letters or numbers anywhere.
jobs.o4_call: tall vertical picture: a calm evening in a plain room. The main character sits on the floor holding one phone to its ear with one front paw, a small brave smile, eyes bright; next to it the big plain grey box stands open and empty, its flaps folded out. The flame on the tip of its tail burns big, golden and bright with a few tiny sparks. LAYOUT: the main character is whole and large in the middle left; the open empty box is whole on the right; plain wall above; the phone screen faces away and is blank; no letters or numbers anywhere.
